description: S458: the §55.1 shared-core vocabulary inside a refinement predicate's parentheses is JUDGED. rate(score: number(min(0) && max(100))) — the §55.3 example — is called with 50 (passes; @shown becomes 50) and then with 150 (fails max(100): the entry check throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT and @shown keeps 50). Before S458 `min` read as an unknown named shape and the emitted check was `(true && true)`, which admitted 150.
rationale: §53.6.1: the §55.1 shared-core vocabulary "MAY appear in refinement-type position" with "Compile-time + runtime boundary check" firing semantics; §55.3 shows `function rate(score: number(min(0) && max(100)))`.
